## Description

Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework where decentralized sub-portfolio agents interact under centralized critic evaluation to optimize cross-asset allocation.

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset sector rotation, decentralized portfolio management, complex competitive market environments.

## Vehicles

Multi-strategy hedge funds, algorithmic asset allocation funds.

## Required data

Cross-asset return streams, macroeconomic indicators, sector sentiment features, portfolio weights history.

## Caveats

Training stability in multi-agent reinforcement learning is notoriously challenging; requires robust reward shaping.
